title: Basilica and Convent of San Francisco, Lima
scope: The standing main Basilica of San Francisco in Lima, its adjoining Franciscan convent and open principal cloister, and the attached Chapel of the Miracle.
limitations: Fine carvings and post-earthquake details are simplified. Towers, lanterns and sanctuary roof heights are estimated from the archival photographs and mapped footprint.
The separately mapped Iglesia de Nuestra Señora de la Soledad, catacombs, furnishings and plaza are outside the scope. The terrain survey does not resolve smaller level changes.
